name: Rowbike Avatar (Experiment)
description: Experimental 3D Rowbike 720 Sport + animated rowing avatar replacement for your rider in Biketerra.

settings.label: Activation mode
settings.description: always = replace your ego avatar immediately; auto = individually replace each rider (you and/or other riders) who has sport: 1 in the biketerra-ride broadcast channel; off = disabled.

settings.label: Rower avatar
settings.description: real = animate your actual Biketerra player avatar (jersey, helmet, face, shadows) on the Rowbike; stylized = procedural fallback rower.

settings.label: Animate stroke when stopped (test)
settings.description: Keep rowing at Demo SPM while stationary so you can preview the animation at 0 km/h.

settings.label: Demo / fallback stroke rate (SPM)
settings.description: Strokes per minute used when no live BLE rower stroke rate is present.

settings.label: Rowbike rail & frame color
settings.description: Primary frame / sliding seat rail color (720 Sport red by default).

settings.label: Rowing lever color
settings.description: Pivoting rowing power arm color (720 Sport blue by default).

settings.label: Show test status / toggle pill
settings.description: Show a small bottom-left pill to toggle Rowbike on/off and view WebGPU diagnostic status.
